items: 【Versatile 360° 2-in-1 Design with Four Usage Modes】2 in 1 laptop touchscreen adapts to your every need. The robust hinge lets you smoothly switch between Laptop, Tablet, Tent, and Stand modes. Ideal for presenting, watching movies, reading, or drawing, it’s the ultimate all-in-one device for work, study, and creativity.

【Ultra-Responsive 120Hz Incell Touchscreen for Precision Work】Business laptops experience flawless touch interaction with our advanced Incell display. Featuring 2600 touch channels and a 120Hz sampling rate, it delivers incredibly low latency, superior accuracy, and smooth pen tracking—The 15.6-inch Full HD (1920x1080) touchscreen responds instantly to your touch, making navigation, drawing, and detailed note-taking intuitive and natural.

【Powerful AMD Ryzen 5 7430U Processor for Multitasking】Tackle demanding workloads with the 6-core, 12-thread AMD Ryzen 5 7430U processor (up to 4.0GHz). It effortlessly handles complex multitasking, creative software, business applications, and entertainment, providing a consistently fast and responsive experience.

【16GB RAM & 512GB SSD for Desktop-Level Speed】Never slow down. The office laptop substantial 16GB DDR4 RAM allows seamless switching between dozens of apps and browser tabs. Combined with the speedy 512GB SSD, enjoy instant boot-ups, quick file transfers, and ample storage for all your projects and media.

【Backlit Keyboard & Comprehensive Connectivity】Pc portatil work comfortably in any environment. The full-size backlit keyboard allows you to type accurately even in low-light conditions. Stay connected with a full set of ports, including USB 3.0, HDMI, Type-C data port, and a headphone jack. Dual-band Wi-Fi 5 and Bluetooth 5.0 ensure stable and fast wireless connections.

【Genuine Win 11 & Your All-in-One Solution】Ready to create and explore from the moment you open it. This 2-in-1 touchscreen laptops comes with the genuine Win 11 operating system pre-installed, offering a secure, modern, and user-friendly platform. With a long-lasting 44Wh battery, it's the perfect, value-packed solution for professionals, students, and creators who demand both power and versatility.
